datasets.name: ea5302f9
queryLines:
with driver_metrics as 
(
    select driver_name,
        sum(race_starts) as race_starts,
        sum(number_of_wins) as total_wins,
        sum(number_of_podiums) as total_podiums,
        sum(case when standing=1 then 1 else 0 end) as total_championships
    from formula1.gold.v_driver_standing
    group by driver_name
    having total_championships >=1
)
select driver_name,
        race_starts,
        total_wins,
        total_podiums,
        total_championships,
        (total_championships * 100) + (total_wins * 10) + (total_podiums * 3) as greatness_score
    from driver_metrics
    order by greatness_score desc
    limit 10

        sum(case when standing=1 then 1 else 0 end) as total_championships
    from formula1.gold.v_constructor_standing

select constructor_name,

        total_wins,

        total_championships,
        (total_championships * 100) + (total_wins * 10) + (total_podiums * 3) as greatness_score

datasets.name: bbd32732
datasets.displayName: Formula One Driver Season Points Accumulation
queryLines:
SELECT
    season,
    round,
    race_name,
    driver_id,
    driver_name,
    points,
    SUM(points) OVER (
        PARTITION BY season, driver_id
        ORDER BY round
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS cumulative_points,
    SUM(points) OVER (
        PARTITION BY season, driver_id
    ) AS total_points
FROM formula1_incr.gold.vw_race_analysis;

datasets.name: 94b08a42
datasets.displayName: Race Outcome Issues and Incident Categorization
queryLines:
SELECT *
FROM formula1_incr.gold.vw_race_analysis
WHERE status IN (
    'Retired',
    'Withdrew',
    'Accident',
    'Collision',
    'Steering',
    'Gearbox',
    'Power Unit',
    'Puncture',
    'Wheel',
    'Track rod'

datasets.name: adfc9568
datasets.displayName: Constructor Race DNF Rates Analysis Summary
queryLines:
SELECT
    constructor_name,
    COUNT(*) AS total_entries,
    SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN status IN (
                'Retired', 'Withdrew', 'Accident', 'Collision',
                'Steering', 'Gearbox', 'Power Unit', 'Puncture',
                'Wheel', 'Track rod'
            )
            THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS dnf_count,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN status IN (
                    'Retired', 'Withdrew', 'Accident', 'Collision',
                    'Steering', 'Gearbox', 'Power Unit', 'Puncture',
                    'Wheel', 'Track rod'
                )
                THEN 1 ELSE 0
            END
        ) / COUNT(*),
        2
    ) AS dnf_percentage
FROM formula1_incr.gold.vw_race_analysis
GROUP BY constructor_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100
ORDER BY dnf_percentage DESC;
